design: Two historical obligations, one independent control and one representation arm per obligation; fresh contexts, inherited model/reasoning, 12 minutes each; assignment alternating arm order across tasks.

primary_outcome: Complete correct all-quantifier theorem or valid counterexample to frozen task; independent source-aware grading after completion.

limits: n=1 per task/method, no statistical efficacy estimate
retrospective reconstructed tasks selected after observing programme mechanisms
